notes.title: Full release next week!
notes.notes:
We want to remind you that "Funny Football" will be released on January 24th. The playtest version of this game will be closed at that time. Instead, we will provide a demo version for people to try this game for free with the default game mode (controlling two football players by your two hands at the same time to against easy AI). You can try the demo version first, then unlock other game modes including the local PVP mode by purchasing the full version after you make sure you really enjoy this game and want to play it with your friends.

we can't wait for you to experience this interesting football game.

notes.title: Release Notes - Update 0.4.5
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where AI football players may stuck with their gatepost when football is near the gatepost.
Fixed an issue where the right joystick of the controller may sometimes not be able to control the movements of the football player #2 as expected.
